avis.titre: Great product aside from the packaging!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A great product that's gentle enough for most skin types I would say! I am going to be so honest, this changed my skincade game and what I thought a hydrating serum could do. This serum is genuinely so silky smooth, it almost has the feeling of an incredibly lightweight silicone primer on the skin. (It also wears flawlessly undet makeup) 10/10 absolutely recommend!

Hyaluronic acid and peptides are two skincare ingredients that I always look for because they help keep my skin looking plump, youthful, and hydrated. I normally use separate products to get those benefits, so I really liked the idea of having them combined into one easy-to-use serum. As I've gotten older, I've become much more intentional about maintaining my skin's elasticity and overall health, so I was excited to try this product at no cost to me in exchange for my honest opinion. Elizabeth Arden has been around for years and has an excellent reputation in skincare, so I felt confident trying this serum. The product comes in individual twist-off capsules, which I really appreciated because each capsule delivers the perfect amount of product while keeping the formula fresh. The serum has a silky, lightweight texture that spread easily across my face and absorbed quickly without leaving behind a greasy or sticky feeling. After using it consistently, my skin felt noticeably softer, smoother, and more hydrated. It also gave my complexion a healthy glow, and my skin looked refreshed and plump. I love that it layers well under moisturizer and makeup without pilling. Overall, I really enjoyed incorporating these capsules into my skincare routine and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking to boost hydration and improve the look of fine lines while achieving healthier-looking skin.
